info.scaling.title: Integer scaling
info.scaling.body:
Enlarges the image in whole-number steps.
Keeps pixels even; borders may remain.
Off lets the image fill more of the screen.
Changes apply immediately.
To undo, select the opposite value.
info.boot.title: Rondo boot logo
info.boot.body:
Replaces the early BaseOS splash with Rondo.
On uses the Rondo logo.
Off restores the saved original.
Visible on the next power-on.
The library opens without a second splash.
Unavailable on unsupported devices.
info.language.title: Language
info.language.body:
Choose the language used by Rondo.
Applies after confirmation.
Select English to return to English.
info.timezone.title: Time zone
info.timezone.body:
Changes the clock display inside Rondo.
Game timestamps remain stored in UTC.
Choose another zone to undo.
info.brightness.title: Brightness
info.brightness.body:
Left/Right changes screen brightness immediately in steps of 5%.
The setting is retained after restart.
The lowest value keeps the screen visible.
info.sound.title: Volume
info.sound.body:
Left/Right changes volume immediately in steps of 5%.
The volume buttons work in the library and in games.
This controls NES audio, separately from the system mixer.
info.lid.title: Sleep on lid close
info.lid.body:
On: closing the lid enters sleep. Off: the lid does not trigger sleep.
A short Power press enters sleep in the library or a game.
Open the lid and press Power to wake. Opening alone does not wake this BaseOS mode.
The game pauses and SRAM is flushed before sleep; audio reopens after wake.

info.slots.title: Saved states
info.slots.body:
Each row shows the saved date and time in your Rondo time zone.
Select a row to see its screenshot.
Older states have no screenshot until saved again.
Overwriting replaces that state; empty rows create a new one.
